note: Pinnwand „Die Akte C-17“ (Runde 9): Tagebuch-Register „Akte“, Karten, rote Fäden, laufende Zusammenfassung. Sachlich, in der Sprache einer Akte; Menschen vor Parolen; keine Gleichsetzung der beiden Repressionsapparate – jede Zeile nennt nur, was die Papiere zeigen. Kurztitel der Karten sind Beschriftungen von Hand, höchstens 20 Zeichen.

strings.board.title: The C-17 File
strings.board.subtitle: What two papers say together
strings.board.summary.title: What the file shows so far
strings.board.summary.empty: Every piece of evidence you find goes on this wall.
strings.board.detail.no_threads: No thread yet – a second paper is missing.
strings.board.memory.note: This is how the file stood then.
strings.board.link.corridor: two plans, one corridor too many
strings.board.link.trains_without_goal: runs with no destination on paper
strings.board.link.wagon_4: the same wagon number: courier van 4
strings.board.link.january: the same three wagons from Karsk
strings.board.note.kordon_burned: Burned: the sheet stayed on the plan wall.
strings.board.note.list_split: Russian sheets with Alexei, German ones with Konrad.
strings.board.note.list_swap: Crosswise: Pjotr’s name travels with Konrad.
strings.board.sum.karsk_wagons: Karsk: three wagons have been rebooked without any destination station being named.
strings.board.sum.karsk_mark: Seal and freight ledger bear the same mark: C-17. Whoever receives the load has been blacked out.
strings.board.sum.berlin_corridor: Berlin: the approved plan conceals a corridor that the earlier draft still shows – behind a wall.
strings.board.sum.berlin_series: C-17 is not a room but a series of contracts. The same mark appears in Karsk and in Berlin.
strings.board.sum.veltrava_wagon: Veltrava: courier van 4 travels under seal C-17/44 to the Commission’s secretariat. Alexei is on the paper as its escort – without having known it.
strings.board.sum.veltrava_train: 11 February, 23:40, platform 5: a non-stop train to Kordon-17, listed as empty stock.
strings.board.sum.paragraph_4: In Russian, paragraph four says ‘escorted persons’; in German, ‘escorted goods’. The text came from the secretariat. Elena noticed – and her minutes book is missing.
strings.board.sum.night_book: Elena handed in her book at the registry at 23:10. The ‘out’ at 23:25 was written by someone else.
strings.board.sum.intake: A wagon every Tuesday. In come ‘files’, out go ‘14 items of escorted goods’ – in the Russian column: 14 persons.
strings.board.sum.cross_check: Evidence against evidence: Alexei’s freight chain is in the intake book line by line – the three wagons from Karsk too, forwarded to Kordon-17 in January.
strings.board.sum.kordon_room: Kordon-17 is a room exactly on the Line: one door to the German hall, one to the Soviet, and between them a waiting bench for fourteen. Drawn by: K. Adler.
strings.board.sum.partners: The partners in C-17 are not the countries but the offices that keep the lists – on Alexei’s side the Transport Department, on Konrad’s the Registration Office.
strings.board.sum.sheet_admit: Konrad said that sheet 7 is his drawing. The sheet stayed on the plan wall – and burned.
strings.board.sum.sheet_pocket: Sheet 7 is in Konrad’s pocket. All Alexei heard was: ‘An office in Berlin.’
strings.board.sum.fire_set: The fire was set: the ramp door was bolted from outside, the fire hose cut through. Whoever did it knew the building.
strings.board.sum.pjotr: On the list for the next special run, Tuesday, 23:40, Door East, third line: Pjotr Iljin – Alexei’s friend from Karsk.
strings.board.sum.halves_split: The file has come apart. Alexei carries the Russian sheets, Konrad the German ones – each can bear witness to what he can read.
strings.board.sum.halves_swap: The file is split crosswise: Pjotr’s name travels with Konrad to Berlin, the German sheets stay with Alexei.
strings.board.sum.halves_elena: The escort list is in Elena’s coat, cloakroom, ticket 27. The two of them have split the rest by language.
strings.board.sum.open_questions: Still open: who set the fire? Where is Elena? And what will become of the people on the next list?
strings.board.link.next_tuesday: the same run: Tuesday, 23:40, Door East
strings.board.link.run_numbers: the same number series: C-17/41 to /44
strings.board.link.shafts: the same shafts: S 1 to S 3
strings.board.note.card_copy: Copy – the card is back in the box.
strings.board.note.card_whole: The other half is in Karsk.
strings.board.sum.c4_books: Karsk: the January freight ledgers were with Lev Sokolov. For the three rebookings the signature has been cut out, and beside it: ‘Dept. T – verbal’.
strings.board.sum.c4_hand: Lev’s carbon copies show what is missing above: ‘Ju. Archipov, Colonel, Transport Department’ – the same hand three times.
strings.board.sum.c4_tunnel: Service tunnel 3 runs beneath the goods yard to a track with no number. The rails are worn shiny, the paint on the sleeper is still soft.
strings.board.sum.c4_house_9: Berlin, Süd 8: the household at number nine has been ‘dissolved’, the file is with the South Branch. The site plan with the three shafts was drawn by K. A.
strings.board.sum.c4_shafts: Marta’s diversions of route 74 lead around three shafts. Warm air rises from poster column S 2 – beneath it lies the registration branch.
strings.board.sum.c4_anna: Index card no. 0417: Anna Lindner, née Kowalenko, is to be ‘repatriated’ in wagon C-17/45 on Tuesday at 23:40. Her daughter Ilse, eight years old: ‘whereabouts unknown’.
strings.board.sum.c4_card_whole: The Russian half of the same card is in Karsk: Anna Kowalenko, taken to Germany by force in 1942, counts there as a ‘returnee’ – onward to the filtration point.
strings.board.sum.c4_wagon: One wagon, four numbers: 24 318, C-17/42, 47 702 – now C-17/45, the paint still wet. That is the wagon for Tuesday.
strings.board.sum.c4_fourteen: In wagon 24 318: two plank benches, a bucket, names in two scripts and 21 January. Below: ‘We are fourteen.’
strings.board.sum.c4_drawer: Drawer Süd 8: 212 cleared households on this section of route 74. 37 carry the red C-17 flag – all of them are missing the right half of the card.
strings.board.sum.c4_signature: The branch’s ventilation plan bears Konrad’s signature too. For the shafts he drew, the houses above them were cleared.
strings.board.sum.c4_wendt: Kommissar Wendt wants all C-17 households in Süd 8 by Monday: the whereabouts of the children, the informants by name.
strings.board.sum.c4_named: Konrad gave Marta Vogel’s name. The Lindner file is proof with signatures on it – and Marta’s name now lies at the branch.
strings.board.sum.c4_protected: Konrad gave no names. Marta and Hanna stay out of the files, Ilse is still ‘whereabouts unknown’ – the Lindner file stays in the cabinet.
strings.board.sum.c4_tuesday: Still open: on Tuesday at 23:40 wagon C-17/45 leaves. Anna Lindner and Pjotr Iljin are on the list.
strings.board.link.signed_ka_14: drawn by K. A. – number 14 too
strings.board.link.house_cards: card indexes right into the stairwell
strings.board.note.card_joined: Laid against the Russian half in Karsk since Tuesday.
strings.board.note.card_sent: On its way to Karsk in Ekdahl’s guidebook.
strings.board.note.card_back_in_box: Back in the box at half past seven – on its way to Kordon-17.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_kolonne: The fourteen from wagon 24 318 are in Karsk: eleven shovel coal in Column 4, two children are in Children’s Home No. 2, one man is in a special settlement in the north.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_card_first: Maria Gorelowa: ‘First comes the card, then the person.’ The right halves wait at the door before the people arrive.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_tarpaulin: For the Swedish journalist the depot stretches a tarpaulin: Column 4 behind the tarpaulin.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_green_wagon: In Berlin a green wagon with barred hatches stands ready for Tuesday. In chalk: ‘Tue – Kordon’.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_sent: Konrad has put the German half of card 0417 and a tracing of sheet 7 into Ekdahl’s guidebook. Bound for Karsk.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_whole: Card 0417 is whole: on the left the Reich, on the right its counterpart office, one stamp across the cut. One register, two states.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_publish: Ekdahl has taken everything: two photographs, Lev’s carbon copies, the Column 4 list. At 23:40 he means to be standing at the Door East.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_protect: Alexei has kept the film; Ekdahl leaves with numbers only. First Lev, Maria and Konrad’s people are to be safe.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_k14: The next construction section takes in Kolonnenstraße 12 to 18 – Hanna’s house too. Drawn by: K. A.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_hidden: Ilse sleeps in the cobbler’s workshop in the basement of number 14 – the only room in the building without a household card.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_tuesday_publish: Tuesday, 23:40: a witness with a flashgun stood at the Door East. The handover was suspended – not cancelled.
strings.board.sum.c4p2_tuesday_protect: Tuesday, 23:40: wagon C-17/45 left without witnesses. Anna Lindner and Pjotr Iljin are on their way to the Karsk filtration point.
